sources.publisher: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MAECI), call published by the Italian Cultural Institute Hong Kong
sources.note: Call text: eligible programme types, excluded programmes, Attanasio reserve fields; no discipline list
Programme types that can be applied for; courses are found on the Universitaly portal
Checked: refers to the Universitaly course search, no downloadable list of courses

subject_rule: The call sets no list of fields: scholarships are offered for study, training and research programmes at Italian institutions for Laurea Magistrale (first year), AFAM, PhD and research projects, and excluded programmes are listed only by type (bachelor's, single-cycle, first- and second-level university Master's, single courses); a reserve of three 'Attanasio' scholarships is limited to international relations, development cooperation and humanitarian and human rights law.
notes: The only majors the call names are the preferred Master's classes of the three-place Attanasio reserve (LM-38 Modern languages for communication and cooperation, LM-52 International relations, LM-62 Political sciences, LM-81 Cooperation for development sciences, LM-87 Social service and social policies) for applicants from Morocco, Nigeria and the Democratic Republic of Congo. These are not recorded as programmes because that reserve is a small exception to a scholarship that otherwise sets no field limit.

Course search is on the Universitaly portal (a search application of the Ministry of Universities and Research); no downloadable course catalogue is published by the scholarship, so no programme rows are recorded.
not_stated: An explicit statement that any discipline is eligible (the call simply sets no field limit)
A list of eligible courses or institutions
fetch_problems: The Universitaly course search is an interactive search and was not used; no document version of its course list is published by the scholarship.
